text: Where volume is written in the trigger: nowhere. trade_above:bar_high carries no volume test and I add none, since the entry is mechanical (C19). My fund-flow check is cmf and elder_pattern (R14); cmf is unread (COM no_data), and elder-lens reads elder_pattern INTERRUPTED, so the TIF proxy is partial and day_vol 0.74 is dry. I hold SUPPORT on W, D and H1 swing_class HH/HL, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.45; rs_leadership is not my field. Clear: cmf above 0 once served. I move on a D close under max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
